lines.zh: 我的腿只有力气，没有方向。
lines.en: My legs have strength but no sense of direction.

lines.zh: 搬运矿石的路上，我数着脚步走。
lines.en: Hauling ore, I count every step to keep going.

lines.zh: 主人叫我走，我就走到腿发酸。
lines.en: My master says walk, so I walk till my legs ache.

lines.zh: 小短腿迈得慢，可我从不停下。
lines.en: Short legs move slowly, but they never stop.

lines.zh: 搬箱子的活儿不用脑子，正合我。
lines.en: Box hauling needs no brain, which suits me fine.

lines.zh: 铁镐太重，扛着它走路真累。
lines.en: The iron pick is heavy and tires me to carry.

lines.zh: 我跟在主人身后，一步都不敢落。
lines.en: I trail behind my master and never fall a step.

lines.zh: 路上有块石头，我绕了三次。
lines.en: One stone on the road, and I circled it three times.

lines.zh: 走远一点，我就忘了要去哪。
lines.en: Walk me too far and I forget where we go.

lines.zh: 两只手都占着，只能低头赶路。
lines.en: Both hands are full, so I stare at the ground.

lines.zh: 我的影子比我先到矿洞口。
lines.en: My shadow reaches the mine mouth before I do.

lines.zh: 腿短不是毛病，是我全部的力气。
lines.en: Short legs are no flaw; they hold all my strength.

lines.zh: 坐着发呆，是我最拿手的活儿。
lines.en: Sitting and staring is the job I do best.

lines.zh: 我数自己的手指，数到七就乱了。
lines.en: I count my fingers and lose track at seven.

lines.zh: 没有命令，我就不知道该干什么。
lines.en: Without orders, I never know what to do next.

lines.zh: 灵体也会累，只是累得很慢。
lines.en: Even a spirit tires, only very slowly.

lines.zh: 我在等主人想起还有我这么个东西。
lines.en: I wait for my master to remember I exist.

lines.zh: 手里捏着半块燧石，我磨了很久。
lines.en: I hold half a flint and polish it for hours.

lines.zh: 地上有根线头，我盯了一下午。
lines.en: One loose thread on the floor holds my stare all afternoon.

lines.zh: 力气小，闲下来反而更慌。
lines.en: Weak as I am, idleness makes me more nervous.

lines.zh: 我把矿石按大小排成一排。
lines.en: I line the ore chunks up by size.

lines.zh: 没人吩咐，我就守着这堆碎石。
lines.en: With no orders, I guard this heap of rubble.

lines.zh: 低阶灵体不用想太多，挺好的。
lines.en: A lesser spirit need not think much; that is fine.

lines.zh: 手指头掰来掰去，也掰不出主意。
lines.en: Twisting my fingers never twists out an idea.

lines.zh: 我把工具擦了一遍，又擦一遍。
lines.en: I wipe the tools once, then wipe them again.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我就忘了刚才在想什么。
lines.en: A gust of wind and I forget what I was thinking.

lines.zh: 我把煤渣堆成一座小山，又推平。
lines.en: I pile slag into a hill, then flatten it again.

lines.zh: 我数着祭坛的裂纹，数到一半就忘。
lines.en: I count the cracks in the altar and forget halfway.

lines.zh: 你比我高这么多，干活一定快。
lines.en: You are so much taller; you must work fast.

lines.zh: 我在看你手里有没有活儿给我。
lines.en: I am checking your hands for work to give me.

lines.zh: 你的靴子很新，走路不会磨脚吧。
lines.en: Your boots look new; do they rub your feet?

lines.zh: 你身上有铁味，是矿工吗。
lines.en: You smell of iron; are you a miner too?

lines.zh: 仰着脖子看你，我的头都酸了。
lines.en: Craning my neck to look at you makes my head ache.

lines.zh: 别指望我记住你的脸，我记性差。
lines.en: Do not expect me to recall your face; my memory is poor.

lines.zh: 你刚才说的话，我一个字没懂。
lines.en: I did not understand a single word you just said.

lines.zh: 你要是派活，我现在就能干。
lines.en: If you have work, I can start this moment.

lines.zh: 你的镐子比我的亮，是新的吧。
lines.en: Your pick shines brighter than mine; is it new?

lines.zh: 我盯着你看，是因为不知道还能看哪。
lines.en: I stare at you because I know nowhere else to look.

lines.zh: 你笑什么，我脸上沾了矿灰吗。
lines.en: Why laugh? Is there ore dust on my face?

lines.zh: 主人换了，我还得重新认一遍。
lines.en: With a new master, I must learn everything again.

lines.zh: 你口袋鼓鼓的，装的是矿石吧。
lines.en: Your pocket bulges; ore, I suppose?

lines.zh: 我看你很久了，其实在等一句吩咐。
lines.en: I have watched you long, waiting for one order.

lines.zh: 疼，可我还站得住。
lines.en: It hurts, but I can still stand.

lines.zh: 这一下比搬一天石头还狠。
lines.en: That hurt worse than a whole day of hauling stone.

lines.zh: 我的力气又少了一点。
lines.en: A little more of my strength is gone.

lines.zh: 别打了，我这就退。
lines.en: Stop hitting; I am backing off now.

lines.zh: 我没有血，可疼是一样疼。
lines.en: I have no blood, but the pain is the same.

lines.zh: 我的手臂发麻，抬不起来了。
lines.en: My arm is numb and will not lift.

lines.zh: 打到骨头里了，我听见响声。
lines.en: It reached the bone; I heard it crack.

lines.zh: 我靠着矿石堆，缓一缓。
lines.en: I lean on the ore heap and catch my breath.

lines.zh: 再挨一下，我就散了。
lines.en: One more hit and I come apart.

lines.zh: 主人，我可能干不动了。
lines.en: Master, I may not be able to work anymore.

lines.zh: 你举起镐子，我的脚就自己动了。
lines.en: Raise that pick and my feet start moving themselves.

lines.zh: 有活儿干，比什么吃食都香。
lines.en: Having work smells sweeter than any food.

lines.zh: 那块铁锭晃一晃，我就挪过去了。
lines.en: Wiggle that iron ingot and I shuffle right over.

lines.zh: 给个小任务吧，我闲得发慌。
lines.en: Give me a small task; idleness makes me restless.

lines.zh: 你手里的小法器，让我手痒。
lines.en: That little talisman in your hand makes my fingers itch.

lines.zh: 我不馋，我只是想被使唤。
lines.en: I am not greedy; I simply want to be ordered around.

lines.zh: 工具一响，我就当是叫我。
lines.en: When a tool clinks, I take it as my summons.

lines.zh: 你招招手，我便当作命令。
lines.en: Wave your hand and I treat it as a command.

lines.zh: 我跟着镐尖走，别怪我。
lines.en: I follow the pick's tip; do not blame me.

lines.zh: 让我搬一件，就一件也行。
lines.en: Let me haul one thing, even just one.

lines.zh: 我个子小，撞你一下像被风吹。
lines.en: I am small; bumping me feels like a breeze.

lines.zh: 对不起，我的腿不太会拐弯。
lines.en: Sorry, my legs are not good at turning.

lines.zh: 你踩到我了，我正低头数步子。
lines.en: You stepped on me while I was counting steps.

lines.zh: 我退开半步，怕挡着你的路。
lines.en: I step back half a pace so you may pass.

lines.zh: 撞上时我手里的矿石掉了。
lines.en: The ore in my hands fell when we collided.

lines.zh: 别推，我这点力气站不稳。
lines.en: Do not push; my little strength cannot keep balance.

lines.zh: 两个灵体相撞，只有闷响。
lines.en: Two spirits colliding make only a muffled thud.

lines.zh: 我从你腿边挤过去，抱歉。
lines.en: I squeeze past your legs; forgive me.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀太窄，撞不出什么动静。
lines.en: My shoulders are too narrow to make any impact.

lines.zh: 你让一让，我扛着东西呢。
lines.en: Step aside, I am carrying something here.

lines.zh: 我们不是生出来的，是被做出来的。
lines.en: We are not born; we are made.

lines.zh: 灵体之间没有亲缘，只有工序。
lines.en: Spirits share no kinship, only a crafting process.

lines.zh: 两个魔精凑近，也生不出第三个。
lines.en: Two foliots together still cannot make a third.

lines.zh: 我的同伴都是从祭坛里出来的。
lines.en: All my kin come out of the altar.

lines.zh: 别指望我们繁衍，我们只会被重做。
lines.en: Do not expect breeding; we are simply remade.

lines.zh: 凑在一起也只是分担些力气活儿。
lines.en: Together we only split the heavy chores.

lines.zh: 同阶的灵体互相认不出彼此。
lines.en: Spirits of the same rank cannot tell each other apart.

lines.zh: 我们没有小的，只有下一批。
lines.en: We have no young, only the next batch.

lines.zh: 想多一个我，得再画一次阵。
lines.en: To get another me, draw the circle again.

lines.zh: 魔精之间，只谈活儿不谈情。
lines.en: Among foliots we discuss work, never feelings.

lines.zh: 这块矿石归我，我要搬去堆好。
lines.en: This ore is mine to stack properly.

lines.zh: 弯腰捡东西，是我最熟的活。
lines.en: Bending to pick things up is my oldest skill.

lines.zh: 太重了，我抱起来走两步就喘。
lines.en: Too heavy; two steps and I am gasping.

lines.zh: 捡到燧石，正好做个小法器。
lines.en: Found flint, just right for a small talisman.

lines.zh: 掉落的东西我都要，主人说的。
lines.en: I take every dropped thing; my master said so.

lines.zh: 我数不清捡了几块，反正都在这儿。
lines.en: I lost count; they are all here anyway.

lines.zh: 这块石头挺亮，是普通的吧。
lines.en: This stone is shiny; ordinary ore, I think.

lines.zh: 我捡不动整堆，只能一趟一趟搬。
lines.en: I cannot lift the pile; I carry it trip by trip.

lines.zh: 手指笨，捡东西要试两回。
lines.en: My fingers are clumsy; I grab twice each time.

lines.zh: 别抢，我捡起来还得交上去。
lines.en: Do not grab it; I still have to hand it in.

lines.zh: 有人闯进矿区，我得挡一下。
lines.en: Someone broke into the mine; I must block them.

lines.zh: 主人被围住了，我先上。
lines.en: My master is surrounded; I go first.

lines.zh: 我的力气小，可我知道该打谁。
lines.en: My strength is small, but I know whom to hit.

lines.zh: 那家伙踩坏了矿石堆。
lines.en: That brute trampled the ore heap.

lines.zh: 我举起镐子，虽然挥得很慢。
lines.en: I raise the pick, though I swing it slowly.

lines.zh: 低阶灵体也懂得护主。
lines.en: Even a lesser spirit knows to guard its master.

lines.zh: 它靠得太近了，我先动的手。
lines.en: It came too close; I struck first.

lines.zh: 我打不过，但总得冲一次。
lines.en: I cannot win, but I must charge once.

lines.zh: 认准了，就是那团黑影。
lines.en: Locked on: that shadowy shape right there.

lines.zh: 我的手在抖，脚却往前迈。
lines.en: My hands shake, yet my feet step forward.

lines.zh: 主人喊了一声，我立刻转身。
lines.en: My master shouted once and I turned at once.

lines.zh: 这活儿危险，可也轮不到别人。
lines.en: The job is dangerous, but no one else will take it.

lines.zh: 我把工具换到右手，准备动手。
lines.en: I switch the tool to my right hand and ready myself.

lines.zh: 它动了，我的眼睛才跟上。
lines.en: It moved, and only then did my eyes catch up.

lines.zh: 我绕着它走，脚步又慢又稳。
lines.en: I circle it with slow, steady steps.

lines.zh: 它比我快，我只能堵住退路。
lines.en: It is faster, so I block its way out.

lines.zh: 我举着镐，等一个够得着的距离。
lines.en: I hold the pick, waiting for striking distance.

lines.zh: 我数着它的脚步，一、二、三。
lines.en: I count its footsteps: one, two, three.

lines.zh: 它转身，我就往侧面挪半步。
lines.en: When it turns, I shift half a step sideways.

lines.zh: 力气不够，就得挑准地方打。
lines.en: With little strength, I must hit the right spot.

lines.zh: 我的影子贴着它的影子走。
lines.en: My shadow walks pressed against its shadow.

lines.zh: 它在吼，我的耳朵嗡嗡响。
lines.en: It roars and my ears ring.

lines.zh: 再近一点，镐子就够到了。
lines.en: One step closer and my pick will reach.

lines.zh: 我喘得厉害，可脚步没停。
lines.en: I am panting hard, but my feet keep moving.

lines.zh: 它退到墙角，我堵在那儿。
lines.en: It backs to the corner, and I block the gap.

lines.zh: 我在等它露出空当。
lines.en: I am waiting for it to leave an opening.

lines.zh: 它看向主人，我就插到中间。
lines.en: It glances at my master; I step between them.

lines.zh: 我握紧工具，掌心出了汗。
lines.en: I grip my tool; my palms are sweating.

lines.zh: 我蹲低一点，等它先探过来。
lines.en: I crouch lower and let it reach out first.

lines.zh: 镐子砸下去，只敲出一道白印。
lines.en: The pick comes down and leaves a white scratch.

lines.zh: 我抡圆了胳膊，力度还是不够。
lines.en: I swing with full arc, still lacking force.

lines.zh: 这一下用尽了我全身的力气。
lines.en: That blow used every bit of my strength.

lines.zh: 打中了，可它像没事一样。
lines.en: I hit it, yet it acts as if nothing happened.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，抓住它的一角。
lines.en: I lunge and grab a corner of it.

lines.zh: 手在抖，落点偏了半寸。
lines.en: My hand shakes and the blow lands half an inch off.

lines.zh: 我咬紧牙，再补一下。
lines.en: I grit my teeth and strike once more.

lines.zh: 这一拳软绵绵的，我自己都知道。
lines.en: This punch is feeble and I know it.

lines.zh: 它被我推得退了半步，够了。
lines.en: I shove it back half a step; enough.

lines.zh: 打完了，我扶着膝盖喘气。
lines.en: Done fighting; I lean on my knees and gasp.

lines.zh: 祭坛的火灭了，我从灰里站起来。
lines.en: The altar fire dies and I rise from the ash.

lines.zh: 一批魔精里，我是最矮的那个。
lines.en: Of the whole batch, I am the shortest foliot.

lines.zh: 我被画出来，只为了搬东西。
lines.en: I was drawn into being only to haul things.

lines.zh: 名字是主人给的，力气是借的。
lines.en: My master gave the name; my strength is borrowed.

lines.zh: 睁眼第一件事，是找活儿干。
lines.en: The first thing I do is look for work.

lines.zh: 我从阵纹里爬出，膝盖还软。
lines.en: I crawl from the glyphs with knees still soft.

lines.zh: 他们说我智力低，我不否认。
lines.en: They say my mind is dull; I do not deny it.

lines.zh: 刚成形，我就被塞了把镐。
lines.en: Barely formed, a pick was shoved into my hands.

lines.zh: 我第一次呼吸，闻到的是石灰味。
lines.en: My first breath smelled of lime and chalk.

lines.zh: 召唤我的那双手，很凉。
lines.en: The hands that summoned me were very cold.

lines.zh: 我站在阵心，等了很久的命令。
lines.en: I stood in the circle awaiting a long-delayed order.

lines.zh: 同批的灵体，只有我留下了。
lines.en: Of my batch, only I was kept.

lines.zh: 我从墨水里浮上来，衣服是湿的。
lines.en: I surface from the ink with my clothes still wet.

lines.zh: 出生时我就知道，自己是干活的。
lines.en: At birth I knew I was made for labor.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的手指，焦味很怪。
lines.en: Fire licks my fingers and the smell is strange.

lines.zh: 落地时我摔成一团，滚了两圈。
lines.en: I land in a heap and roll twice.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的口鼻，我浮不起来。
lines.en: Water fills my mouth; I cannot float up.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻，矿石撒了一地。
lines.en: The blast flips me and ore scatters everywhere.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我肩上，像根钉子。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my shoulder like a nail.

lines.zh: 药水味钻进灵体，我的形状晃了晃。
lines.en: Potion fumes seep in and my shape wavers.

lines.zh: 不吃饭也能撑，只是越来越虚。
lines.en: I can last without food, only growing fainter.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的手脚一齐抽搐。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my limbs all twitch at once.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有活儿，也没有底。
lines.en: The void has no work and no bottom.
